en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town nestled in a valley, photographed from a nearby field or hillside. In the foreground are tilled soil and a few simple farm buildings. Behind them stands a compact cluster of late‑19th‑ / early‑20th‑century houses and villas, some with half‑timbered façades. On a slight rise to the right dominates a large Gothic‑revival church with a tall, slender spire. Forested hills surround the town in the distance. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image itself.
